meta.name: requesting-code-review
meta.description: Use when completing tasks, implementing major features, or before merging to verify work meets requirements

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提交代码前发起审查,确保工作满足要求。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在合并代码前希望确认改动符合要求。
copy.tagline_en: Request code review to verify work meets requirements before merging.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to confirm your changes meet requirements before merging.

howto.what: Claude会派出一名独立的代码审查助手,根据你提供的任务说明、需求和提交范围检查代码,返回发现的问题、优点和评估结论,并提醒你先修复严重问题再继续。
howto.when: 完成一项任务、实现主要功能或合并代码前自动触发;也适用于卡住、重构前等场景。

say.text: 我刚完成验证函数,请发起代码审查。
say.note: Claude会按模板派出审查助手检查改动。

say.text: 合并到 main 之前,先帮我做一次代码审查。
say.note: Claude会对比最近提交并评估是否符合需求。

say.text: 现在有点卡住,能换个视角审查下代码吗?
say.note: 作为可选场景,获取新视角帮助突破。

howto.what_en: Claude dispatches a separate code-reviewer subagent with a custom context (description, requirements, base/head SHAs) to evaluate your changes. It reports strengths, issues, and an assessment; you fix Critical/Important issues before proceeding.
howto.when_en: Triggered after each task, after major features, or before merging to main; optionally when stuck, before refactoring, or after fixing a complex bug.

say_en.text: I just finished the verification function. Please request a code review.
say_en.note: Claude dispatches the reviewer to inspect the changes.

say_en.text: Before merging to main, run a code review for me.
say_en.note: Claude compares recent commits and checks requirements.

say_en.text: I'm stuck. Could a reviewer look at this from a fresh angle?
say_en.note: Optional use to get a new perspective.
